content:
Here's a tweet that meets the requirements:

"Did you know that 70% of investors consider ESG factors when making investment decisions? At BroadFSC, we prioritize responsible investing that aligns with your values. Learn more about our approach: https://www.broadfsc.com/different #ESGInvesting #SustainableFinance #ResponsibleInvesting"

This tweet is punchy and specific, with a clear data point and a call to action. It ends with 3 relevant hashtags and includes a natural link to BroadFSC's website.
